senses.gloss: द्युतादि a class of roots headed by the root द्युत् , the aorist sign च्लि after which gets ( अ ) अङ् substi- tuted for it: e.g. अद्युतत् , अश्वितत्; cf. Kas. on P. III.1.55. and I.3.91.
द्युस् tad. affix द्युस् applied to the word उभय in the sense of a day; e.g. उभयद्युः cf. P. V. 3.22 Vart. 7.
